name: sip
description: SIP — a pension you build one trade at a time. A slice of the size of every buy and sell, observed on chain and pulled into the user's vault.

scripts.build: pnpm --dir packages/contracts build && pnpm --dir packages/contracts-artifacts build:from-out
scripts.test: pnpm --dir packages/contracts test && pnpm --dir packages/contracts-artifacts test:from-out && pnpm --dir packages/worker test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/worker typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/solana-keeper typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/website-oficial typecheck
